result.summary: The food delivery app page appears visually well-structured with no significant broken elements. All content renders correctly with proper layout, icons, and text.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the ramen card appears with a white outline on a dark background, while the heart icon on the pizza card below has a dark circular background, creating slight inconsistency in the favorite button styling across cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite/heart button styling across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
